content.text:
Five files import and call the function from `packages/lib/currencyConversions.ts`. No test files reference it.

- `packages/app-store/paypal/lib/Paypal.ts` imports it from `@calcom/lib/currencyConversions` and calls it at line 89.
- `packages/app-store/paypal/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` imports it from there and calls it at line 85.
- `packages/app-store/stripepayment/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` imports it from there and calls it at line 111.
- `packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/PaymentService.ts` imports it from there and calls it at line 113.
- `packages/app-store/hitpay/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` imports it from there and calls it at line 92.

Three other files have a function with the same name that is not the one in `packages/lib`. I left them out of the list.

- `packages/app-store/btcpayserver/lib/currencyOptions.ts` defines its own version at line 41.
- `packages/app-store/btcpayserver/lib/PaymentService.ts` and `packages/app-store/btcpayserver/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` both import that BTCPay copy from `./currencyOptions` or `../lib/currencyOptions`.
- `packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/currencyConversions.ts` defines another local copy at line 27. Nothing imports it, since the HitPay files above import from `@calcom/lib`.

`packages/lib/currencyConversions.ts` itself is only the definition, so I didn't count it as a caller.
